heading: Travel expenses of Senior Executive Service candidates
lead: Employing agencies may pay candidates for Senior Executive Service positions travel expenses incurred incident to preemployment interviews requested by the employing agency.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective 9 months after Oct. 13, 1978, and congressional review of provisions of sections 401 through 412 of Pub. L. 95–454, see section 415(a)(1), (b) of Pub. L. 95–454, set out as an Effective Date note under section 3131 of this title.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 95–454, title IV, § 409(b), Oct. 13, 1978, 92 Stat. 1173.)
